aboutHeading: About Four Square Cabinets in Epping
aboutText: Four Square Cabinets has been crafting custom cabinetry for homes in Epping and across Melbourne for years. Our team, led by Jaspal, is dedicated to quality workmanship and exceptional customer service. From kitchens and bathrooms to living rooms and beyond, we deliver tailored solutions that enhance your living space. Highly recommended by satisfied customers like Dhara Ganatra and Aziz Araz.
servicesText: At Four Square Cabinets, we specialise in a wide range of cabinetry services, from complete kitchen fit-outs to custom TV units and fireplaces. Using high-quality materials like MDF boards, cladding, and PVC sheets, we ensure durability and style. Serving Epping and nearby suburbs with pride.
